correctness.rationale: Averaging over the coordinate-swap isometry reduces arbitrary Euclidean pullbacks to \(Q_\rho=u^2+\rho v^2\) without worsening two-sided bounds. Three exact test directions give the universal lower bound \(M_\rho/m_\rho\ge 2^{5/3}/3\). At \(\rho=3/2\), exact derivative signs on the two norm branches show the full ratio range is \([3/2^{4/3},2^{1/3}]\), attaining that lower bound. The analytic proof covers all directions; the numerical replay is supplementary.

value.rationale: The conjugate Day--James family is a classical self-dual/Birkhoff-symmetric source of non-Hilbert planes. The pair \((3,3/2)\) is the first non-Hilbert conjugate case with an integer exponent above two and lies outside the checked restricted Hilbert-distance criterion. An exact optimal ellipsoid and exact distance give a structural benchmark, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
